notes:
What's new in 0.1.88:
• Phone speakers (In development): line phones up with this computer's microphone, swap films without losing the room, move or dock the speaker panel, and use this computer as a speaker. It shows as "PC speaker" over the film.
• Family Watch (In development): watch together with small face tiles; the host approves who joins.
• Podcasts: following a very large feed now works, and you can bring in podcasts from a list file or a public feed link.
• Phone backup: Back up now works when an earlier request is waiting, status is clearer, and .tif photos and .mpg videos are accepted.
• Upload sees the files you pick again, Video Playlists can be renamed again, and Reset to default in Appearance goes back to the Cinema Library look.
• Web player: Auto quality uses the measured speed and says why, and Skip intro follows the playhead.
• Safety tightening for paired TVs, Jellyfin-style app passwords and guest error messages, plus many smaller fixes from our own code reviews.
• Built from commit 82411bd2f, Oct 14, 2026, 9:15 AM Eastern.
